summary: Milestone 4 adds newsletter audiences distinct from channel lists, full-post publish emails, segment filters, and public signup forms on Cloudron beta.
detailed_changes: Added newsletter entities seeded from the three channel lists, with staff create/archive and subscriptions that can target a newsletter without dropping channel lists.
Publish emails now include the rendered article body once per publication, and staff can limit a send to contacts confirmed on two newsletters.
Added public and embeddable signup at /newsletters/{slug}/signup with double opt-in and per-audience unsubscribe.
affected_areas: User groups affected: public subscribers; staff editors
Public impact: newsletter signup and fuller publish emails
Internal impact: consent and suppression rules unchanged; no new live-send authorization
